title: 2. Provenance: the owner's words are the lowest layer

sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: Vignettes keep the owner's words verbatim; everything derived from them points back with derived-from, so a record's origin can be traced without a human copy of it.

sections.name: body
sections.label: The evidence
sections.content: Decision 77e04b19 (ratified 2026-10-27): vignettes are verbatim Tier-0 notes; records derived from them are suggestions with derived-from; "the owner affirms the story, and work does not wait on it". Remedy 6e141bd2: a record derived from a passage the owner wrote carries the owner's confidence; its falsifier is the owner still affirming record by record after four weeks. RFC-046 (srs) stamps createdBy as testimony, never authority. The owner, 2026-10-30: "The vignettes provide the lowest level input", and provenance "is still interestingly hard".

sections.name: open
sections.label: Open
sections.content: Decision 77e04b19 is due for revisit around 2026-11-21. Is that the session where affirmation becomes optional?
